name: Terrain Shading with Direct and Ambient Light
definition: Computes the final color of a terrain surface point by combining albedo, direct sunlight (modulated by shadow and cloud shadow), and hemispheric ambient light (sky and ground bounce modulated by AO).
summary: Terrain Shading with Direct and Ambient Light combines direct sunlight with a two-component hemispheric ambient model, distinguished by its use of baked normal maps and bias-based shadow tracing.
